description: Trigger, retry, or cancel CI/CD pipelines and individual jobs. Pipeline actions: create (run pipeline on ref with variables or typed inputs), retry (re-run failed jobs), cancel (stop running pipeline). Job actions: play_job (trigger a manual/delayed job with variables), retry_job (re-run a single job), cancel_job (stop a running job). Related: browse_pipelines actions 'job'/'logs' for job details.

action.description: Action to perform: create, retry, cancel, play_job, retry_job, cancel_job

force.description: Force cancellation of the job Required for 'cancel_job' action(s).

additionalProperties.description: Input value: string, number, boolean, or array of strings

inputs.description: Typed pipeline inputs defined in the .gitlab-ci.yml spec (GitLab 17.10+). Keys must match input names in the pipeline spec. Required for 'create' action(s).

job_id.description: The ID of the job Required for 'play_job', 'retry_job', 'cancel_job' action(s).

job_variables_attributes.description: Variables to pass to the job Required for 'play_job' action(s).

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline Required for 'retry', 'cancel' action(s).

ref.description: The branch or tag to run the pipeline on Required for 'create' action(s).

variables.description: Legacy variables to pass to the pipeline (key-value pairs with optional type) Required for 'create' action(s).

name: manage_pipeline
